facts.text: The hotel sits on Midosuji Boulevard, with access to an Osaka Metro station connecting to three subway lines.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Osaka is centrally located along the famed Midosuji Boulevard, the Champs-Élysées of Osaka, with seamless access to an Osaka Metro station connecting to three subway lines.

facts.text: The hotel is a one-minute walk from Exit 7 of Hommachi Station on the Osaka Metro, in a building with direct underground access.
facts.excerpt: Just a one-minute stroll from Exit 7 of Hommachi Station on the Osaka Metro, The St. Regis Osaka resides in the building with direct underground access.

facts.text: The building was designed by Japanese architecture firm Nikken Sekkei and stands 27 stories above Midosuji Avenue.
facts.excerpt: Designed by famed Japanese architect firm Nikken Sekkei, The St Regis Osaka stands 27 stories above Midosuji Avenue

facts.text: Midosuji is lined with ginkgo trees and is designated as a cultural asset of the city.
facts.excerpt: Lined with beautiful ginkgo trees, Midosuji is now recognised as one of Osaka's 100 Best Green Spaces and is designated as a cultural asset of the city.

facts.text: Guestroom headboards are made of Kawashima silk with motifs of gingko and cherry blossoms.
facts.excerpt: beautiful Kawashima silk headboards feature motifs of gingko and cherry blossoms, symbolic representations of Osaka and Japan

facts.text: Rooms have walk-in closets and spacious bathrooms with Japanese-style bathtubs.
facts.excerpt: walk-in closets, and spacious bathrooms with Japanese-style bathtubs

facts.text: Rooms are enriched with artwork, ceramics and Kyoto silks.
facts.excerpt: Carefully selected artwork, ceramics, fine finishes, and Kyoto silks enrich the contemporary interiors

facts.text: The St. Regis Suite is inspired by Osaka's flowing waterways and the artistry of the Azuchi-Momoyama era.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Osaka's flowing waterways and the artistry of the Azuchi-Momoyama era, the suite elevates the hotel's design narrative

facts.text: The St. Regis Suite uses bespoke Nishijin-ori silk and gold accents.
facts.excerpt: Soft textures, luminous gold accents, and bespoke Nishijin-ori silk weave a refined design story throughout the suite

facts.text: Every suite stay includes butler service, 24-hour breakfast and Evening Cocktails at The St. Regis Bar.
facts.excerpt: Every Suite stay is enhanced by the signature St. Regis Butler Service, 24-hour breakfast served at your convenience, and Evening Cocktails at the iconic St. Regis Bar.

facts.text: Breakfast is served 24 hours a day, in the restaurant or in the privacy of a suite.
facts.excerpt: our 24-hour breakfast experience ensures your perfect morning meal is ready whenever you desire

facts.text: La Veduta is an Italian restaurant with an interior inspired by a Tuscan villa.
facts.excerpt: Our Italian restaurant features an elegant interior inspired by a Tuscan villa.

facts.text: Brasserie REGINE is a modern French brasserie.
facts.excerpt: Experience the casual sophistication of Brasserie RÉGINE, a modern French brasserie

facts.text: Brasserie REGINE is curated under the culinary direction of Michelin two-starred Chef Ryuta Iizuka, owner-chef of Ryuzu.
facts.excerpt: Curated under the culinary direction of Michelin two-starred Chef Ryuta Iizuka, owner-chef of the acclaimed Ryuzu

facts.text: Teppanyaki WAJO showcases premium Japanese beef, Seto Inland Sea seafood and seasonal Kyoto vegetables.
facts.excerpt: our teppanyaki restaurant showcasing premium Japanese beef, Seto Inland Sea seafood, seasonal Kyoto vegetables

facts.text: The hotel's signature Bloody Mary is the Shogun Mary, made with yuzu, wasabi powder and soy sauce.
facts.excerpt: a locally inspired interpretation of the classic Bloody Mary, by adding a zest of fresh yuzu citrus, spicy wasabi powder, and soy sauce.

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar is entered through walnut doors from the hotel's 12th-floor lobby.
facts.excerpt: Through grand walnut doors from the hotel’s 12th-floor lobby, The St. Regis Bar welcomes guests

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar is an enchanting environment unmatched in all of Osaka.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Bar welcomes guests to an enchanting environment, unmatched in all of Osaka.

facts.text: Behind the bar, a mural of Osaka's past and present styled after Scenes In and Around Kyoto features the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Behind the bar, a mural of Osaka’s past and present—styled after Scenes In and Around Kyoto—features The St. Regis Osaka.

facts.text: The bar offers cocktails, champagne, afternoon tea and jazz.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy cocktails, champagne, afternoon tea, and jazz in this elegant setting.

facts.text: The hotel's afternoon tea evolves through the seasons, with distinctive themes and occasional collaborations.
facts.excerpt: At The St. Regis Osaka, our Afternoon Tea ritual evolves through the seasons, inspired by distinctive themes and occasional exclusive collaborations

facts.text: The Evening Ritual includes a signature Champagne Sabrage ceremony.
facts.excerpt: featuring our signature Champagne Sabrage ceremony performed daily at St. Regis hotels worldwide.

facts.text: The Evening Ritual takes place daily on the 12th floor.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to join this ceremonious ritual daily at 5:00 p.m. on the 12th floor.

facts.text: The St. Regis Garden on the 12th floor is inspired by traditional Japanese stone garden architecture.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Garden located on the 12th floor, inspired by traditional Japanese Stone Garden architecture.

facts.text: The IRIDIUM featuring SOTHYS spa is on the 14th floor.
facts.excerpt: Iridium featuring Sothys offers tailored skin and body treatments in a serene retreat on the 14th floor of The St. Regis Osaka.

facts.text: Spa treatments are given by aestheticians trained at the Sothys Institut in Paris.
facts.excerpt: expert care by aestheticians trained at the Sothys Institut in Paris.

facts.text: The gym is exclusively for overnight guests.
facts.excerpt: Exclusively for overnight guests, our gym offers home-style machines for a refreshing workout.

facts.text: St. Regis Butlers can assist with packing and unpacking, garment pressing, shoe shining and dining reservations.
facts.excerpt: St. Regis Butlers may assist with packing and unpacking services, welcome beverage service, garment pressing, shoe shining, dining reservations

facts.text: Butler garment pressing covers two garments per person, per day.
facts.excerpt: This gracious service includes pressing of two garments per person, per day.

facts.text: Butler Service can be reached at any hour by email, inside or outside the hotel.
facts.excerpt: St. Regis Butler Service is accessible at any hour via email.

facts.text: Osaka Castle is about a half hour from the hotel on foot.
facts.excerpt: This beautiful castle and large park area is about a half hour away from the hotel by foot.

facts.text: Osaka's main shopping area, Minami, is one train station away.
facts.excerpt: Osaka’s main shopping area is one train station away from the hotel.

facts.text: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan is about 20 minutes by train from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: just 20 minutes by train from this hotel near Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan

facts.text: The closest airport is Osaka International Airport, Itami.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Osaka is Osaka International Airport - Itami (ITM).

facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Osaka.

facts.text: The hotel is currently enhancing select guestrooms.
facts.excerpt: We are currently enhancing select guestrooms as part of our ongoing dedication to refining the St. Regis experience.

facts.text: Suites are themed around flowers and trees including lilies, pines and wisteria.
facts.excerpt: each suite at The St. Regis Osaka is uniquely designed around themes of flowers and trees, including lilies, pines, and wisteria

facts.text: Suites are inspired by traditional Japanese flowers and trees such as chrysanthemums, pines and wisteria.
facts.excerpt: inspired by traditional Japanese flowers and trees such as chrysanthemums, pines, and wisteria
